title: Connect Frontend to Your REST API with Fetch & Chart.js
description: Use JavaScript Fetch API to consume your Django/FastAPI backend and display data with Chart.js visualizations
objective: Students will connect their HTML dashboard to their backend REST API using the Fetch API with async/await, handle JWT authentication, add Chart.js visualizations, and configure CORS

steps.title: Enable CORS on Your Backend
steps.instructions:
Before your frontend (port 5500) can call your backend (port 8000), you need to enable CORS.

**For Django:**
```bash
pip install django-cors-headers
```

Update `settings.py`:
```python
INSTALLED_APPS = [
    ...
    'corsheaders',
]

MIDDLEWARE = [
    'corsheaders.middleware.CorsMiddleware',   # Add FIRST (before CommonMiddleware)
    'django.middleware.common.CommonMiddleware',
    ...
]

CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS = [
    'http://localhost:5500',
    'http://127.0.0.1:5500',
    'http://localhost:3000',
]
```

**For FastAPI:**
```python
from fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware

app.add_middleware(
    CORSMiddleware,
    allow_origins=['http://localhost:5500', 'http://127.0.0.1:5500'],
    allow_credentials=True,
    allow_methods=['*'],
    allow_headers=['*'],
)
```

Start your backend server:
```bash
# Django:
python manage.py runserver

# FastAPI:
uvicorn main:app --reload
```

Verify CORS works by opening your browser console (F12) and running:
```javascript
fetch('http://localhost:8000/api/students/').then(r => r.json()).then(console.log)
```

If you see student data in the console, CORS is working.

steps.title: Load Students from the API with Fetch
Add Create and Delete with Authentication
Add Chart.js Visualizations
Test Everything and Submit
steps.instructions:
Final testing checklist. Make sure your backend is running and test each feature:

**API Connection:**
- [ ] Page loads students from the API (check Network tab)
- [ ] Error message shows if API is down
- [ ] Loading spinner shows while fetching

**CRUD Operations:**
- [ ] Student list loads from API
- [ ] Search filters students in real time
- [ ] Add Student modal creates via POST (with auth token)
- [ ] Delete button removes student via DELETE (with auth token)
- [ ] Success/error alerts show for each operation
- [ ] Unauthenticated create shows warning

**Charts:**
- [ ] Bar chart shows top students by marks with color coding
- [ ] Doughnut chart shows city distribution
- [ ] Charts update when data changes (add/delete student)
- [ ] Charts are responsive (resize properly)

**Authentication:**
- [ ] Can log in via console: `login('admin', 'admin123')`
- [ ] Token is stored in localStorage
- [ ] Token is sent in Authorization header for POST/DELETE

**Responsive:**
- [ ] Works on mobile (375px)
- [ ] Charts stack vertically on mobile
- [ ] Table scrolls horizontally on mobile

Open Chrome DevTools (F12) and check:
1. **Console tab** — no red errors
2. **Network tab** — API requests return 200/201
3. **Application tab > Local Storage** — tokens are stored after login

**Submit:**
1. Your complete project folder (index.html + css/ + js/)
2. Screenshots showing: student table loaded from API, charts with data, successful create, Network tab showing API calls
3. Console log showing "Loaded X students from API"

expected_output: A frontend dashboard that loads data from your REST API using the Fetch API, supports authenticated create/delete operations with JWT tokens, displays Chart.js visualizations, and shows proper loading/error states
